theorem lg_target {α β : Type u} {f : Set (α → β)} {s : Set α} (hf : f.Finite) (hs : s.Finite) : (f <*> s).Finite := by
  let f_set := f
  let s_set := s
  have h_finite_f : f.Finite := hf
  have h_finite_s : s.Finite := hs
  let product_set := f ×ˢ s
  have h_finite_product : product_set.Finite := by
    apply finite_prod
    exact h_finite_f
    exact h_finite_s
  let image_set := ⋃ g ∈ f, g '' s_set
  have h_finite_images : ∀ g ∈ f, (g '' s_set).Finite := by
    intro g hg
    apply image_finite
    exact h_finite_s
  have h_finite_union : image_set.Finite := by
    apply finite_bigunion
    exact h_finite_product
    exact h_finite_images
  exact h_finite_union
